resources.string: Saved in the vault. On Linux, Telos applies DoT through resolvectl when it is available; DoH stays preference-only.

One desktop-id or package per line with allow, deny, or vpn. Stored under ~/.config/telos/app-routing.txt. Process-level enforcement is not applied yet; the kill-switch still drops non-allowlisted egress on Linux.

Block and allow lists are stored under vault ~/.config/telos/ (dns-block.txt, dns-allow.txt). A NextDNS configuration ID applies DoT via resolvectl on Linux when available. Local lists alone stay preference-only unless dns-stub.port is set and nftables can redirect DNS to that stub. Windows and macOS store preferences only.
